name: Ephron
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Ephron offered the field freely, but Abraham insisted on paying, and weighed four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant. The field of Machpelah and its cave were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace, and there he buried Sarah.

Jacob charged them to bury him with his fathers in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace, where Abraham and Sarah, Isaac and Rebekah, and Leah lie buried.

note.label: Genesis 49: What Shall Befall the Twelve Tribes in the Last Days
